heroHeadline: Day 719: Sheinbaum Warns Against 'Intervencionismo' in Baja California Sur After Chihuahua Tour Stop Snubbed by Gov. Maru Campos
heroSubtitle: September 20, 2026 marks Day 719 of Claudia Sheinbaum's presidency. At her Baja California Sur accountability-tour stop, she warned against foreign intervention — "México es un país libre, independiente y soberano, bastante nos costó" — as Governor Víctor Manuel Castro Cosío pledged state protections for wetlands, dunes, mangroves and marine reefs. The day before, September 19 (Day 718), Sheinbaum joined the Segundo Simulacro Nacional 2026 earthquake drill from Ciudad Juárez, Chihuahua, the 23rd stop of her tour; Governor Maru Campos, with whom relations have cooled since the 2024 Sierra del Pinal CIA-operative case, limited their contact to a brief airport greeting despite having requested a meeting on security and water issues. On September 18 (Day 717), Sheinbaum's Security Cabinet disclosed a record 59-million-liter fuel seizure in Guanajuato and she confirmed her 22nd phone call with President Trump, saying trade talks were "advancing well" ahead of Round 4 USMCA negotiations September 28–29 in Washington.
